Foreign ministers from the UK, France and Germany (the "E3") met in Istanbul on Friday 23 October 2026 with counterparts from the "R4" group — Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Egypt — plus Italy, to urge US-Iran diplomacy rather than a new round of military strikes.

Al Jazeera's photo caption and copy name UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband as present alongside German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani. Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said after the meeting that none of the eight countries approved of further military intervention against Iran, warning this would "exacerbate tensions and further expand the conflict."

French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said a further escalation between Iran and the US "would create nothing but losers" and would have "very serious consequences for hydrocarbon prices." Italy's Tajani said the aim was "de-escalation to guarantee freedom of navigation." The group called on both sides to "exercise the utmost restraint."
